name: Alchemical Genius (Master Chymist)
body:
An alchemical genius’ alter ego is a monster of intelligence and insight rather than muscles and stamina.

Requirements

To qualify to become an alchemical genius, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

This alters requirements.

Spellcasting Ability to create 3rd-level extracts.
Special: Cognatogen or inspiring cognatogen class feature, collective memory or intuitive understanding discovery.
Features
Class Skills

The alchemical genius’ class skills are Knowledge (all) (Int), Linguistics (Int), Perception (Wis), Sense Motive (Wis), Spellcraft (Int) and Use Magic Device (Cha).

This replaces class skills.

Psychic Mutation (Su)

An alchemical genius is forced to switch to her mutagenic form when she suffers a critical hit or fails a Will save.

This alters and otherwise functions as mutate.

Advanced Cognatogen (Su)

An alchemical genius gains Advanced Cognatogen as a bonus feat at 1st level. She cannot use the following advanced mutagens: burly, draconic mutagen, grand mutagen, greater mutagen, feral mutagen, growth mutagen.

This alters advanced mutagen.

Subtlety (Ex)

At 3rd level, an alchemical genius’ mind becomes impervious to mental attacks. The alchemical genius gains a +2 bonus on Will saves against mind-affecting spells and effects.

This bonus increases to +4 at 7th level and to +6 at 9th level.

This replaces brutality.
